title: Report theorem-type definition surface

traversal_policy.roots: Every top-level theorem declared in namespace KFOL.Report in Report.lean; traverse its type, never its proof body.
traversal_policy.project_expansion: Recursively traverse declaration types, non-proof definition/opaque bodies, and reachable inductive constructor types in modules KFOL.*, Paper or Report.
traversal_policy.proof_erasure: Lean.Meta.isProof erases proof-valued subterms with local binders in scope, including proof-only helper definitions. Proposition expressions themselves remain: predicates and hypotheses contribute their mathematical definitions.
traversal_policy.inductives: Reachable inductive declarations include their constructors and mutual inductive declarations. Kernel-generated recursors are indexed by their types; their computation rules are supplied by Lean's inductive kernel.
traversal_policy.external_boundary: Record directly referenced external constants and their declared types without unfolding their definitions or traversing the external dependency closure.
traversal_policy.purpose: A reproducible index for reviewing the mathematical meaning of public statements. It does not establish that a definition matches the manuscript, replace human review, or replace the independent source/import/axiom audits.

review_order: Read each public theorem's literal type in Report.lean and its per-theorem slice below.

Review central KFOL/Definitions files, then the extra semantic definitions reached in algorithm/round/machine files. Source fingerprints and exact declaration edges identify that complete project surface.
Review the imported GameTheory and ComplexityLib/Cslib boundary types separately. External boundary entries are interfaces, not a claim that their full definition closure was audited here.
Use the existing whole-project axiom/import audit for proof dependencies; they are deliberately absent from this report.

∀ {Role : Type u} (owner : Role) (Action : Type v) (nonempty : Nonempty Action)
  (next : Action → KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree Role),
  (KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.node owner Action nonempty next).possibleWinners =
    if ∃ a, (next a).possibleWinners = {owner} then {owner} else {player | ∃ a, player ∈ (next a).possibleWinners}

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role) (N : ℕ) {Summary : Type v}
          [inst_2 : Fintype Summary] (code : Fin (N + 1) → Summary),
          (∀ (n k : Fin (N + 1)),
              code n = code k →
                ∀ (m : Fin N),
                  c ∈
                      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                        ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c (↑n) (↑m + 1)).sequentialValues order) ↔
                    c ∈
                      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                        ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c (↑k) (↑m + 1)).sequentialValues order)) →
            Function.Injective code ∧ N + 1 ≤ Fintype.card Summary

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] {C : Type v}
  [inst_1 : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Structure C] {P : Type w}
  [inst_2 : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Structure P] (_three : Fin 3 ↪ Role)
  (hC : KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) C) (e : C),
  (∀ (r : Role) (c : C), KFOL.Core.join _three (KFOL.Core.operation r e c) e = e → KFOL.Core.join _three c e = e) →
    ∀ (R : Set Role),
      R ≠ Set.univ →
        ∀
          (η :
            (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom ↥(KFOL.Core.ideal hC _three e)
              ↥(KFOL.Core.Native.atomicRestriction R)),
          (∀ (c : ↥(KFOL.Core.ideal hC _three e)) (r : Role),
              ↑(η c) = KFOL.Core.Native.atom r ↔ KFOL.Core.operation r e ↑c ≠ e) →
            KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) P →
              ∀ (q : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom P C),
                Function.Surjective ⇑q →
                  ∀
                    (label :
                      (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom P
                        ↥(KFOL.Core.Native.atomicRestriction R)),
                    (∀ (u : P) (hu : KFOL.Core.join _three (q u) e = e), label u = η ⟨q u, hu⟩) →
                      KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (Option C)

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Fintype Role] (_three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  Fintype.card (KFOL.Core.Native Role) = Fintype.card Role + 2 ∧
    (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
        e.variableCount ≤ Fintype.card Role → e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → e.Holds (KFOL.Core.Native Role)) ∧
      (KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity _three).Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ∧
        ¬(KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity _three).Holds (KFOL.Core.Native Role) ∧
          (KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity _three).variableCount = Fintype.card Role + 1 ∧
            ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (KFOL.Core.Native Role) ∧
              (∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                  (∀ e ∈ T, e.variableCount ≤ Fintype.card Role) → ¬KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) T) ∧
                ∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                  KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) T → ∃ e ∈ T, Fintype.card Role + 1 ≤ e.variableCount

  (∀ (D : Set (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)),

                ∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (left right : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role),
          KFOL.Rounds.Game.UsesOnly a b left →
            KFOL.Rounds.Game.UsesOnly a b right →
              ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
                Countable { probe // probe.UnaryGenerated } ∧
                  (left.sequentialValues order = right.sequentialValues order ↔
                      ∀ (context : KFOL.Rounds.Game.Context Role),
                        context.BooleanMenus →
                          (c ∈ KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((context.fill left).sequentialValues order) ↔
                            c ∈ KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((context.fill right).sequentialValues order))) ∧
                    (left.sequentialValues order = right.sequentialValues order ↔
                        ∀ (context : KFOL.Rounds.Game.Context Role),
                          context.BooleanMenus →
                            KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((context.fill left).sequentialValues order) =
                              KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((context.fill right).sequentialValues order)) ∧
                      (left.sequentialValues order = right.sequentialValues order ↔
                        ∀ (probe : KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm),
                          probe.UnaryGenerated →
                            (c ∈
                                KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                                  ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a left
                                        (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a c probe)).sequentialValues
                                    order) ↔
                              c ∈
                                KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                                  ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a right
                                        (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a c probe)).sequentialValues
                                    order)))

∀ {Role : Type u} {Index : Type v} [inst : Fintype Role] [Nontrivial Role] [Nonempty Index] (owner : Role)
  (branches : Index → KFOL.Strategic.Tree Role),
  ∃ S,
    ∃ (_ : S.Nonempty),
      ∃ term,
        S.card ≤ Fintype.card Role - 1 ∧
          term.IsCore ∧
            KFOL.Strategic.possibleWinners (KFOL.Strategic.compile (fun i => branches ↑i) term) =
              KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.possibleWinners owner branches

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (owner : Role),
  (KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.possibleWinners owner fun i => KFOL.Strategic.Tree.leaf ↑i) = {r | r ≠ owner} ∧
    ∀ (S : Finset Role),
      S.Nonempty →
        owner ∉ S →
          (KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.possibleWinners owner fun i => KFOL.Strategic.Tree.leaf ↑i) = {r | r ≠ owner} →
            S = Finset.univ.erase owner ∧ S.card = Fintype.card Role - 1

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] {g : KFOL.Strategic.Tree Role} (p : KFOL.Strategic.Profile g),
  (KFOL.Strategic.IsNash p ↔

    (KFOL.Strategic.IsSubgamePerfect p ↔
      ∀ {h : KFOL.Strategic.Tree Role} (q : KFOL.Strategic.Profile h),
        KFOL.Strategic.Restriction p q →
          GameTheory.IsNash (KFOL.Strategic.gameForm h) (KFOL.Strategic.winningPreference Role) fun x => q)

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} (components : Var → KFOL.Strategic.Tree Role) (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
  KFOL.Strategic.value (KFOL.Strategic.compile components t) =
    KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => KFOL.Strategic.value (components x)) t

∀ (n : ℕ),
  ∃ equation term,
    equation.WellFormed ∧
      equation.gates.length = 6 * n + 3 ∧
        KFOL.Circuit.operationCount equation.gates = 4 * n + 1 ∧
          KFOL.Circuit.edgeCount equation.gates = 8 * n + 2 ∧
            equation.unfold = some (term, term) ∧ 2 ^ n ≤ (term.table (Sum.inl true)).card

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (equation : KFOL.Circuit.Equation KFOL.Reset.Symbol Var),
  have x := KFOL.Reset.structureOf KFOL.WinnerSet.reset;
  equation.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔
    equation.WellFormed ∧
      ∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        (∀ (j : Var), ∃ stage, valuation j = KFOL.Reset.chainValue three stage) →
          ∃ value, equation.eval valuation = some (value, value)

∀ {Role : Type u} (_three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (formula : KFOL.Reductions.CNF),
  (KFOL.Circuit.ResetCNF.equation formula).WellFormed ∧
    (KFOL.Circuit.ResetCNF.equation formula).gates.length =
        7 * (KFOL.Reductions.ResetUnion.support formula).length + 2 * (List.flatten formula).length + 3 ∧
      KFOL.Circuit.operationCount (KFOL.Circuit.ResetCNF.equation formula).gates =
          5 * (KFOL.Reductions.ResetUnion.support formula).length + 2 * (List.flatten formula).length + 1 ∧
        have x := KFOL.Reset.structureOf KFOL.WinnerSet.reset;
        (KFOL.Circuit.ResetCNF.equation formula).Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ ¬KFOL.Reductions.Satisfiable formula

∀ (n : ℕ),
  ∃ equation term,
    equation.WellFormed ∧
      equation.gates.length = 6 * n + 3 ∧
        List.countP
              (fun gate =>
                match gate with
                | KFOL.Circuit.Gate.input a => true
                | KFOL.Circuit.Gate.func a a_1 => false)
              equation.gates =
            2 * n + 2 ∧
          KFOL.Circuit.operationCount equation.gates = 4 * n + 1 ∧
            KFOL.Circuit.edgeCount equation.gates = 8 * n + 2 ∧
              equation.unfold = some (term, term) ∧
                (term.table (Sum.inl true)).card = 2 ^ n ∧
                  (∀ A ∈ term.table (Sum.inl true), A.card = n + 1) ∧
                    term.occurrences (Sum.inl true) = 2 ^ n ∧
                      ∀ (Role : Type u) (_three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (other : KFOL.Reset.Term (Bool ⊕ ℕ × Bool)),
                        (∀ (valuation : Bool ⊕ ℕ × Bool → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                            other.eval valuation = term.eval valuation) →
                          2 ^ n ≤ other.occurrences (Sum.inl true) ∧
                            2 ^ n + 1 ≤ other.leafCount ∧ 2 ^ (n + 1) + 1 ≤ other.size

∀ {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (s t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var),
  (s.step t).feasible = {D | D = ∅ ∨ ∃ A ∈ s.feasible, ∃ C ∈ t.feasible, C.Nonempty ∧ D = A ∪ C}

∀ {Var : Type v} {Var' : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq Var] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Var'] (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var)
  (inner : Var → KFOL.Reset.Term Var'),
  KFOL.Reset.Term.root (FirstOrder.Language.Term.subst t inner) = (inner t.root).root ∧
    (∀ {Role : Type u} (valuation : Var' → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        KFOL.Reset.Term.eval (FirstOrder.Language.Term.subst t inner) valuation =
          t.eval fun i => (inner i).eval valuation) ∧
      ∀ (j : Var'),
        KFOL.Reset.Term.table (FirstOrder.Language.Term.subst t inner) j =
          KFOL.Reset.Term.minimize
            ((FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t).biUnion fun i =>
              (t.table i).biUnion fun A =>
                Finset.image (fun C => Finset.image (fun k => (inner k).root) A ∪ C) ((inner i).table j))

∀ {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var),
  (∀ (j : Var), (t.table j).card ≤ t.occurrences j) ∧
    ∑ j ∈ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t, (t.table j).card ≤ t.leafCount ∧ t.size + 1 = 2 * t.leafCount

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Finite Role] (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role)
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role)
  (assessment : (game.serialized order).information.BehavioralAssessment),
  assessment.IsSequentiallyConsistent ⋯ →
    ∀ (h : game.execution.History) (ht : ¬game.execution.terminal h.state) (i : Role),
      assessment.belief i (game.serialSite order h ht i) = game.productBelief order assessment.strategy h ht i

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Finite Role] (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role)
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role)
  (strategy : (i : Role) → (game.serialized order).information.BehavioralPolicy i),
  ∃ assessment,
    assessment.strategy = strategy ∧
      assessment.IsSequentiallyConsistent ⋯ ∧
        ∀ (h : game.execution.History) (ht : ¬game.execution.terminal h.state) (i : Role),
          assessment.belief i (game.serialSite order h ht i) = game.productBelief order strategy h ht i

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role)
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
  Finite game.execution.History ∧
    Finite (game.serialized order).execution.History ∧
      game.information.PerfectRecall ∧
        (game.serialized order).information.DecisionRecall ∧
          (∀ (p : game.Position), game.execution.Reachable p) ∧
            (∀ (h : game.execution.History), game.information.IsSubgameRoot h) ∧
              (∃ bound, 0 < bound ∧ game.execution.BoundedHorizon bound) ∧
                (∃ bound, 0 < bound ∧ (game.serialized order).execution.BoundedHorizon bound) ∧
                  ∀ (payoff : Role → (game.serialized order).execution.History → ℝ),
                    ∃ assessment, assessment.IsSequentialEquilibrium ⋯ ⋯ payoff

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Fintype Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (x y : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1),
      0 < x + y →
        ∃ row col,
          (row 0).toReal = y / (x + y) ∧
            (col 0).toReal = y / (x + y) ∧
              ∀ (profile : (i : Role) → PMF (Fin (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b i + 1))),
                (((KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b)
                                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.diagonalTable a b
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b x hx0 hx1)
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b y hy0 hy1))).mixed.play
                          (GameTheory.Profile.update profile a row))
                        a).toReal =
                    x * y / (x + y) ∧
                  (((KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b)
                                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.diagonalTable a b
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b x hx0 hx1)
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b y hy0 hy1))).mixed.play
                          (GameTheory.Profile.update profile b col))
                        a).toReal =
                    x * y / (x + y)

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (left right : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role) (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role)
          (x y : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1),
          left.sequentialValues order = {KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b x hx0 hx1} →
            right.sequentialValues order = {KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b y hy0 hy1} →
              (x ≤ y ↔
                ∀ (probe : KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm),
                  probe.UnaryGenerated →
                    probe.rate < 1 →
                      c ∈
                          KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                            ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a right
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a c probe)).sequentialValues
                              order) →
                        c ∈
                          KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                            ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a left
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a c probe)).sequentialValues
                              order))

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
      (∀ (term : KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm),
          (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b term).sequentialValues order =
            {KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b ↑term.rate ⋯ ⋯}) ∧
        {q | ∃ term, term.UnaryGenerated ∧ term.rate = q} = Set.Icc 0 1 ∧
          ∀ (q : ℚ) (h0 : 0 ≤ q) (h1 : q ≤ 1),
            ∃ term,
              term.UnaryGenerated ∧
                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b term).sequentialValues order =
                  {KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b ↑q ⋯ ⋯}

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (G : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role)
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role), G.value = G.sequentialValues order

∀ {Role : Type u} (labels : Fin 2 ≃ Role),
  Function.Injective (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels) ∧
    (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice (labels 0) A B) =
          ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1 || (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).1,
            (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2 && (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).2)) ∧
      (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice (labels 1) A B) =
            ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1 && (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).1,
              (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2 || (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).2)) ∧
        (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.rename (Equiv.swap (labels 0) (labels 1)) A) =
              ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2, (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1)) ∧
          ∀ (p : Bool × Bool), (∃ A, KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A = p) ↔ ¬(p.1 = true ∧ p.2 = true)

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [Nontrivial Role] (G : KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree Role),
  ∃ pruned binary,
    ∃ (pruning : KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.Prunes (Fintype.card Role - 1) G pruned),
      pruning.PreservesValues ∧
        (∃ depth, KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.DepthLE depth pruned) ∧
          pruned.Compiles binary ∧ KFOL.Strategic.possibleWinners binary = G.possibleWinners
